posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
We played a game last night against Dawn in Atlantis. Because two of our four heroes were from Vengeance, I don't want to go into any of the particulars of how we  did it, but we defeated Dawn in three rounds, with a Kraken getting the last blow.

 

After Dawn's third turn, we knew there was no way to avoid her flipping and becoming immune on her fourth turn, so began discussing how to respond. But then we asked '_CAN_ we do 42 points of damage to her this round?', and found that the answer was Yes!

 

Having Jim's Hat and a Sudden Contract in Chrono Ranger's starting hand were a big part of our success.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Crono-Ranger, Team leader Tachyon, Legacy and either Fanatic or Wraith I'd go for.  

You still need a good start, you really need inspiring presence/by any means first round, and the other one puts it in the bag.  Then it is all about focusing lots of damage instances on Dawn, which Tach Fanatic and Crono can do well.

+2 martyr is 7 to yourself, 9 to the villain, 10 if you add By any Means.  Add Embolden and her base power doing 6 or 8 and it's a quick game vs. almost any villain you can focus down, if you get retribution you can take down the boss yourself.

I was in Insula Primalis with Legacy, Fanatic, Adept and Visionary and Fanatic hit +5 damage.  She did Smite the transgressor/Exorcism/Martyr for 34 damage.  Then Adept let her play Retribution for 31 damage, 65 in one round, Fanatic died on the environment turn, but finishing Voss was easy at that point.

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
arenson9:

Having Jim's Hat and a Sudden Contract in Chrono Ranger's starting hand were a big part of our success.

 

I happen to remember that by Chrono Ranger's third turn, By Any Means and Ultimate Target were both on Dawn. Chrono Ranger played two different cards that dealt 1 damage each and then used the Compound Bow to do deal 1 damage two more times. Each of those four instances of dealing damage were increased by two for a total of 12 damage. 

 

That only leaves 68 other points and we had 11 other hero turns in which to do damage. The Kraken did the last three points, so that's 65 points of damage over 11 hero turns for an average of just shy of six points per hero turn. Factor in that the Bounty which increases all damage by one (Ultimate Target?) was on Dawn by the second hero turn, boosting every attack. On Haka's first turn, for instance, an Elbow Smash and his base power did a total of seven points of damage. Also factor in that with the other Bounty, Chrono Ranger got a power use the first time each turn that Dawn dealt damage. Only got to take advantage of that once, but every little bit counts.

 

Ah! I also just remembered that Dawn had  an Ongoing which caused her to hit herself.  I think she took that damage twice.

 

Yes, the Vengeance heroes dished out a lot of damage, but not so amazingly well as to prove that they are overpowered.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
The bounty which boosts all damage received by a target is By Any Means. Ultimate Target is the one that gives Chrono Ranger +1 damage to the target and lets him use a power the first time that target deals damage each turn. The ongoing which causes Dawn to hit herself would be Channel the Eclipse.

Just to fill in the gaps there ;).

Sounds like a pretty epic game, anyway. Reminds me of the one we had against Advanced Plague Rat (first time ever for me - we never normally play Advanced anything at home) on the London game day at Leisure Games a few weeks ago, where I played Chrono Ranger and was down to 1hp after about two rounds. The rest of the group managed to gang up to keep me alive for a round longer until someone (can't remember whether or not it was me) managed to actually kill Rat after a total of three or possibly four rounds. Something like that.

At home, I think our quickest win was Iron Legacy in three rounds. I expect our quickest loss was the omgwtf game we had against Apostate last weekend - after previously defeating us only once before (and then not with particularly horrendous ease), he totally destroyed us in three rounds.
